name: smwpatches-moving-castle-block-offscreen-handling-fix-v1
title: Moving Castle Block Offscreen Handling Fix v1.1
description:
This patch makes it so the castle block sprite is now properly handled when offscreen. Previously, it would never despawn - preventing sprite slots from being erased and leading to other sprites not spawning - despite the 'Process when off screen' option being unchecked in Tweaker.

v1.1
------
Added support to LM 3.0. Suboffscreen now used register B as well, so XBA had to be changed to stack push / pull.
